These receptor and ligand files are unchanged official AutoDock Vina tutorial data.

Source repository: https://github.com/forlilab/AutoDock-Vina

- `1iep_receptor.pdbqt`: `example/basic_docking/solution/1iep_receptor.pdbqt`
- `1iep_receptorH.pdb`: `example/basic_docking/data/1iep_receptorH.pdb`
- `1iep_ligand.sdf`: `example/basic_docking/data/1iep_ligand.sdf`

Upstream software license: Apache-2.0. Protein entry: PDB 1IEP.
These fixtures validate software execution, not prospective drug discovery.
